observationContract.comparison: For equivalent requests and initial object state, compare HTTP status, response headers and body, returned bytes, object metadata, list membership and ordering, and read-back state after writes and refusals. Normalize only run-specific values with an explicit reason. The official-emulator storage matrix is local regression evidence, not production evidence.
observationContract.finalArtifact: Run the production comparison and official-emulator storage-probe against the same copied binary; retain its SHA-256, source commit, clean build status, and both comparison outputs. Independent closure review must approve the same artifact before promotion.

scopeDecisions.decision: Storage Security Rules language, matching, publication and denial semantics belong to STORAGE-RULES. STORAGE-OBJECT exercises Firebase requests under a fixed allow rule and checks credential identity at the API boundary.
scopeDecisions.recommendation: Approve the split while retaining an ID-token request and a permission-error control in this parent.

scopeDecisions.decision: Cloud Functions object triggers and event delivery belong to FUNCTIONS-EVENTS.
scopeDecisions.recommendation: Approve; object responses and persisted state remain in STORAGE-OBJECT.

scopeDecisions.decision: Bucket creation, bucket configuration and IAM administration are outside this object-data parent. The default Firebase Storage bucket is a recorded precondition, not a compared object operation.
scopeDecisions.recommendation: Approve and require a separate parent decision for bucket administration.

scopeDecisions.decision: Signed URLs, the XML API, object ACLs, compose and notification administration are outside the two REST dialects declared for this parent.
scopeDecisions.recommendation: Approve for this parent; retain GCS JSON copy and rewrite because the current Storage contract claims them.

scopeDecisions.decision: Archived object generations, lifecycle transitions and versioning configuration are outside the current-generation object contract. Generation changes and preconditions on the current object remain in scope.
scopeDecisions.recommendation: Approve only if the owner accepts a current-generation-only claim; otherwise add a versioning condition before freeze.

scopeDecisions.decision: The finite production corpus uses small bounded objects. The existing fireemu 256 MiB object cap and process memory budget are not established as production parity by this closure.
scopeDecisions.recommendation: Keep the local cap disclosed as a bounded known difference; ask the owner whether it blocks COMPAT_VERIFIED or belongs to a separate large-object condition.

scopeDecisions.decision: This closure compares raw Firebase Storage and GCS JSON HTTP requests. SDK client behavior, including browser and mobile transport details, is outside this REST corpus.
scopeDecisions.recommendation: Approve this protocol boundary and retain the official-emulator SDK smoke checks as regression evidence only.

checks: Media upload, returned metadata, stored bytes and read-back agree; a refused upload publishes no object.
Multipart metadata and bytes persist together; malformed multipart input leaves no object.
Initiation, offset query, chunks, finalization and cancellation return production responses and read-back state; wrong offsets do not commit.
Full, bounded, open-ended and suffix ranges return the expected bytes and headers.
Token creation, reuse, deletion and token-bearing download behavior match; private token values are normalized and never published.
Get and update preserve bytes and generation, apply metadata changes and metageneration as production does.
Delete and repeated delete responses match, and metadata/media reads confirm absence.
Prefix, delimiter, flat and paged results match; maxResults including zero, pageToken continuation, order and no duplicate or skipped names are checked.
Overwrite changes generation, resets or changes metadata as observed, and returns the new bytes on read-back.
JSON API media and multipart inserts return metadata and persist bytes; malformed insert does not publish.
Resumable initiation, Content-Range chunks, offset mismatch and finalization match production, with read-back of committed bytes.
Metadata and media get, full and ranged bytes, selected generation and response headers match.
Get, PATCH and update preserve object bytes and change metadata and metageneration as production does.
Delete, repeated delete and read-after-delete status, body and state match.
Prefix, delimiter, maxResults including zero, pageToken and supported filters match, including combined item/prefix pages, ordering and exhaustion.
Copy and rewrite return production metadata and copy bytes; missing source and conditional refusal leave destination unchanged.
Match and not-match, zero-create and stale generation conditions on write, read and delete return the right response and post-state.
Match, not-match, stale and malformed metageneration guards on metadata update and delete preserve state on refusal.
Valid MD5 and CRC32C are reported; mismatches and malformed declarations return production errors without publishing bytes.
Both dialects distinguish missing metadata, media, update and delete with production status and error shape.
Missing, malformed and insufficient credentials produce the production status and error shape, and refused writes publish nothing.
Missing and invalid object names in upload, get and list paths return the production error shape without mutation.
Malformed and unsatisfiable ranges, including the empty-object boundary, return production status, headers and body without mutation.
Owner ADC access token can execute the authorized object operations in each dialect; no credential bytes enter public evidence.
A real Firebase Auth ID token reaches the Firebase object API under an allow rule, with identity, success and refusal controls; token bytes stay private.
Object bytes, metadata, generation and deletion written through one dialect are observed consistently through the other.
The same copied binary and SHA-256 produce a complete strict-profile production comparison and official-emulator storage-probe comparison, with a clean source-bound build receipt.
An independent reviewer approves every declared condition, scope decision, production recording and final-artifact binding before COMPAT_VERIFIED.
